artboards.title: D — The palette is the surface

annotations.text:
D2 — "Keyboard shortcuts: separate modal or settings page?"

Five directions plus what exists today, drawn against app/globals.css light tokens. Each note argues against itself where it deserves to.

THE CONSTRAINT EVERY DIRECTION INHERITS

DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS is derived from STATIC_COMMANDS, never resolveCommands(), because a binding is persisted by shortcut id and a command that can vanish would strand the override behind it. tests/unit/commands.test.ts asserts the 19 ids exhaustively — toHaveLength, not just toContain — so adding a binding is a deliberate test edit, and a dynamic command may never own one.

THE LOOSE END

The dispatcher calls isAvailable(command, ctx) before it runs anything. The palette honours that and greys the row. The shortcuts modal never asks — so it is the one surface where a switched-off extension's binding looks identical to a working one. Each direction states its answer.
